2305 Ryan Drive
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$350,000, 5 bed, 2.50 bath, 2,690 SF, MLS# 574236

Looking for a beautiful home for your growing family? This large, 5BR/2.5BA home with 2690 sq.ft., is the home for you! Located in the House Creek subdivision, it is zoned for House Creek Elementary. ( House Creek Elementary hosts grade K-5, is rated “A”, and is a National Blue Ribbon School.) The spacious master bedroom on the first floor has an ensuite bathroom with a large walk-in closet. The sitting room in the master can also double as an office, or just a lounge area. The four large minor bedrooms are upstairs. Several rooms have walk-in closets. Upstairs you will also find a large living area for your family to gather for games, TV, or just visiting. 
The downstairs boasts a spacious living area with a wood burning fireplace , a gorgeous kitchen, a dining room, a large pantry, and a laundry room. Outside of the home, you will see the wonderful green grass, a garden, a shed, and a wood fence.  Call today to make this home yours!

2 full bath, 1 half bath
